text:
Jordyn: coffee machine down. it died mid-espresso. need a 3-word rally cry to revive it. GO!
Alex: Breathe. Steam. Brew.
Maya: Pour the vibes
Devon: Summon the beans
Priya: Tap the reservoir
Sam: Coffee gods awaken :pray:
Jordyn: love these. keep 'em coming — we need a chant for morale
Alex: clap-clap-clink (that's the drum)
Maya: Ritual (optional):
```
1) Smile
2) Spin the dial
3) Whisper 'reheat'
```
Devon: unplug -> count to five -> plug. works more often than you'd think :grin:
Ops-bot: System: water-level low alert. refill reservoir to clear fault
Priya: on it. bringing a measuring cup
Sam: victory dance when it's back :tada:
Devon: machine rebooted. espresso flowing. chant accepted :coffee:
